activity_summary: You ate the middle of the loaf after the children had already counted you. Susanna asked to take Golding to the river after dinner. You gave them the water toward the middle of the afternoon, and not the whole of it. The book stays on the shelf until dinner is eaten. Joan keeps the three when you and Anne go toward Shottery, and not before. You told the table the stone was back on the sheet.
